title: Published Azure Advisor Performance catalog
scope: All 150 unique Recommendation IDs in the retrieved public Performance reference page, including historical recommendations.
assessmentBasis: Recorded explicit ID mappings with matching content hashes; not independent human semantic review.
limitations: Complete means all published IDs on this single retrieved page, not all Azure performance guidance or live Advisor findings.
Payload preserves a digest of upstream text rather than copying the article. A different extraction/fingerprintScope is not hash-compatible.
Source retrieval and LLM-authored semantic assessments are not human approval, live validation or a vendor support commitment.
No historical inventory was available in this fingerprint representation, so new/removed upstream IDs cannot be established.
Catalog retrieval time is the timestamp of the Microsoft Learn fetch tool output, not publication time.
Only opening networking items were semantically read. Inventory extraction is not a claim that the other catalog recommendations are current or covered.

assessments.notes: IP-group/prefix rule reduction addresses network-rule processing pressure, but this corpus check does not establish the catalog's measured unique-source/destination limit condition.
The catalog names classic Microsoft.Network/frontdoors. Modern Front Door probe guidance is related, but different resource scope prevents counting this as full or partial type-specific coverage.
v2 maximum capacity/subnet headroom addresses the autoscaling branch; the catalog also describes high utilization and v1 manual scaling. No live Advisor finding or utilization is inferred.
